With t_Allocated as (
  select
    aa.DrVoucherTNo as VoucherTNo,
    aa.DrVoucherSNo as VoucherSNo,
    -1 * sum(aa.Amount) as AllocatedAmount
  from DrCrAllocation aa, Voucher bb, Voucher cc
  where aa.DrVoucherTNo = bb.TNo
    and aa.CrVoucherTNo = cc.TNo
  group by
    aa.DrVoucherTNo,
    aa.DrVoucherSNo
  union all
  select
    aa.CrVoucherTNo as VoucherTNo,
    aa.CrVoucherSNo as VoucherSNo,
    sum(aa.Amount) as AllocatedAmount
  from DrCrAllocation aa, Voucher bb, Voucher cc
  where aa.DrVoucherTNo = bb.TNo
    and aa.CrVoucherTNo = cc.TNo
  group by
    aa.CrVoucherTNo,
    aa.CrVoucherSNo
), t_Bill as (
  select
    aa.TNo,
    aa.ccInvoiceNo As BillNo,
    aa.ccInvoiceDate As BillDate
  from ccInvoice aa
  union all
  select
    aa.TNo,
    aa.ServiceBillNo As BillNo,
    aa.ServiceBillDate As BillDate
  from ServiceBill aa
), t_Balance as (
        select
            a.TNo,
            a.SNo,
            a.VoucherDate,
            b.VoucherNo,
            a.LocationCode,
            d.BillNo as BillNo,
            d.BillDate as BillDate,
            trunc(sysdate) - nvl(d.BillDate, a.VoucherDate) as BillAge,
            a.AccountCode,
            a.Amount as VoucherAmount,
            c.AllocatedAmount,
            a.Amount - nvl(c.AllocatedAmount, 0) as BalanceAmount
        from VoucherDetail a, Voucher b, t_Allocated c, AccountOpening d
        where a.TNo = b.TNo
            and a.TNO= c.VoucherTNo(+)
            and a.SNo = c.VoucherSNo(+)
            and a.ModuleTNo = d.TNo(+)
            and b.VoucherNo = 'OPENING'
            and round(a.Amount - nvl(c.AllocatedAmount, 0), 0) != 0
        union all
        select
            a.TNo,
            a.SNo,
            a.VoucherDate,
            b.VoucherNo,
            a.LocationCode,
            d.BillNo,
            d.BillDate,
            trunc(sysdate) - nvl(d.BillDate, a.VoucherDate) as BillAge,
            a.AccountCode,
            a.Amount as VoucherAmount,
            c.AllocatedAmount,
            a.Amount - nvl(c.AllocatedAmount, 0) as BalanceAmount
        from VoucherDetail a, Voucher b, t_Allocated c, t_Bill d
        where a.TNo = b.TNo
            and a.TNO= c.VoucherTNo(+)
            and a.SNo = c.VoucherSNo(+)
            and b.ModuleTNo = d.TNo(+)
            and b.VoucherNo != 'OPENING'
            and round(a.Amount - nvl(c.AllocatedAmount, 0), 0) != 0
)
select
    x.LocationCode,
    y.PartyName,
    x.billno,
    x.voucherdate,
    x.BillAge,
    Sum(x.VoucherAmount) As VoucherAmount,
    Sum(x.AllocatedAmount) As AllocatedAmount,
    sum(x.BalanceAmount) as TotalBalance,
    X.AccountCode,
    y.partytypecode

from t_Balance x, Party y
where x.AccountCode = y.PartyCode
    and y.PartyTypeCode IN ('CUSTOMER')
group by  x.LocationCode,
    y.PartyName,
    x.AccountCode,
    y.partytypecode,
    x.BillNo,
    x.BillAge,
    x.voucherdate
having round(sum(x.BalanceAmount), 3) != 0
order by y.PartyName, x.LocationCode

select x."TNO",x."COMPANYCODE",x."FINANCIALYEARCODE",x."LOCATIONCODE",x."DOCTYPECODE",x."PURCHASEBILLNO",x."PURCHASEBILLDATE",x."PARTYBILLNO",x."PARTYBILLDATE",x."PURCHASEORDERTNO",x."CURRENCYUNITCODE",x."CURRENCYVALUE",x."PARTYCODE",x."SUMOFAMOUNT",x."SUMOFFOOTERAMOUNT",x."PURCHASEBILLAMOUNT",x."REMARK",x."ITEMWISEFOOTER",x."SUPPLIERCODE",x."MANUFACTURERCODE",x."SUMOFFOOTERAMOUNTWITHRATE",x."JOBORDERTNO",x."DELIVERYORDERTNO",x."RAKETNO",x."CREATOR",x."BILLEDON",x."EXCISEBILLNO",x."EXCISEBILLDATE",x."BILLEDITEM",x."UPDATELANDINGIFSUPPLEMENTARY",x."TRANCTIONTYPECODE",x."TRANSACTIONTYPECODE",x."NATUREOFSUPPLYCODE",x."PORTCODE",x."BILLOFENTRYTNO",x."CREATIONTIME",x."FREIGHTADVANCEAMOUNT",x."TDSPAYEECATEGORYCODE",x."FREIGHTPOSTEDTOSTOCK",x."INCLUDEINPURCHASEBILL",x."TAXINROUND",x."BILLINROUNDFIGURE",x."PURCHASEBILLAMOUNTBEFOREROUND",x."ROUNDOFF", cast('A' as varchar2(10)) panel from purchasebill x

select x."TNO",x."COMPANYCODE",x."FINANCIALYEARCODE",x."LOCATIONCODE",x."DOCTYPECODE",x."DEPARTMENTCODE",x."EMPLOYEECODE",x."PURCHASEORDERNO",x."PURCHASEORDERDATE",x."DELIVERYDATE",x."CURRENCYUNITCODE",x."CURRENCYVALUE",x."WORKORDERTNO",x."PARTYCODE",x."QUOTATIONTNO",x."RATECONTRACTTNO",x."DELIVERYORDERTNO",x."INDENTTNO",x."PURCHASEORDERAMOUNT",x."SUBJECTTEXT",x."REFERENCETEXT",x."LETTERTEXT",x."TITLETEXT",x."REMARK",x."ITEMWISEFOOTER",x."SUMOFAMOUNT",x."SUMOFFOOTERAMOUNT",x."AGENTCODE",x."CREDITDAYS",x."STORAGELOCATIONCODE",x."STOCKDATE",x."COMMISSIONRATE",x."CREATOR",x."FREIGHTTYPECODE",x."FREIGHTCONTRACTTNO",x."FREIGHTRATE",x."ISEVENTRANSACTION",x."COMPARATIVESTATEMENTTNO",x."XPLANT",x."EXPARTYPLANT",x."LIFTINGFROMCITYCODE",x."UNLOADINGCITYCODE",x."TRANCTIONTYPECODE",x."TRANSACTIONTYPECODE",x."PAYMENTBYLC",x."NATUREOFSUPPLYCODE",x."PREDI",x."DELIVERYSCHEDULEWITHPO",x."ITEMWISESCHEDULE",x."REFERENCEPURCHASEORDERTNO",x."CREATIONTIME",x."PAIDAMOUNT",x."ROYALTYPERCENTAGE",x."ROYALTYPENALTYPERUNIT",x."ISFULLADVANCE",x."POADVANCEAMOUNT",x."PAYMENTADVICELOCATIONCODE",x."MARINEINSURANCETNO",x."MARINEINSURANCEAMOUNT",x."SAUDAPATRAKNO",x."SAUDAPATRAKDATE",x."LENDINGONGROSS",x."SHIPTO",x."CUSTOMERCODE",x."PENDINGSOTNO",x."ISOPENSPEC",x."QUANTITY",x."MAILSTATUS",x."MAILID", cast('A' as varchar2(10)) panel from purchaseorder x

Select a.tno As ReferenceModuleTNo,
       A.COMPANYCODE As companyCode,
       a.PartyBillNo As ReferenceModuleNo,
       A.PARTYBILLDATE As ReferenceModuleDate,
       b.pbpassAmount - b.sumoftdsamount  As ReferenceModuleAmount,
       a.PurchaseBillAmount As pbpassamount,
			 (Nvl(b.PAIDAMOUNT,0) + Nvl(b.PAIDINADVANCE,0) + Nvl(b.SUMOFTDSAMOUNT,0) ) AS PaidAmount,
       --Nvl(E.AMOUNT, 0) + Nvl(g.allocatedamount, 0) AS PaidAmount, -- +
       --Nvl(h.returnamount, 0) As PaidAmount,
			 b.PbpassAmount - (Nvl(b.PAIDAMOUNT,0) + Nvl(b.PAIDINADVANCE,0) + Nvl(b.SUMOFTDSAMOUNT,0)) As BalanceAmount,
      /* 02-JUL-2024
       (nvl(B.pbpassAmount, 0) -
        Nvl(b.sumoftdsamount,0) -
        nvl(E.Amount, 0)  -
       Nvl(g.allocatedamount, 0) + Nvl(h.returnamount, 0) -
       (Select Nvl(Sum(x.amount), 0)
           From paymentadvicereference x, PURCHASEBILLDETAIL Y
          Where x.referencemoduletno = Y.PURCHASEORDERTNO
            And Y.TNO = A.TNO) - Nvl(h.returnamount, 0)) As BalanceAmount,

			 Nvl((Select Sum(x.amount)
             From paymentadvicereference x, PURCHASEBILLDETAIL Y
            Where x.referencemoduletno = Y.PURCHASEORDERTNO
              And Y.TNO = A.TNO),
           0) As advanceamount,
			 */
			 Nvl(b.PAIDINADVANCE,0) As AdvanceAmount,
       -- 0 As tobepaidagainstbill,
       a.PartyBillDate As InvoiceDate,
       'PURCHASEBILL' As ReferenceModuleCode,
       a.PartyCode,
     --  b.pbpassdate As duedate,
        (Select Max(aa.grndate) + Max(x.creditdays)
          From PURCHASEORDER         x,
               PURCHASEBILLDETAIL    Y,
               purchasebillgrndetail z,
               grn                   aa
         Where x.tno = y.purchaseordertno
           And y.tno = a.tno
           And y.tno = z.tno
           And aa.tno = z.grntno
           And rownum = 1) As DueDate,
       a.locationcode,
       (Select yy.itemnaturename
          From item xx, itemnature yy, purchasebilldetail zz
         Where xx.itemnaturecode = yy.itemnaturecode
           And xx.itemcode = zz.itemcode
           And zz.tno = a.tno
           And Rownum = 1) As itemnature,
       (Select Min(grndate)
          From grn x, purchasebillgrndetail b
         Where x.tno = b.grntno
           And b.tno = a.tno

        ) As UnloadingDate,
       (Select Nvl(GETPARTYNAME(AGENTCODE), 'DIRECT')
          From PURCHASEORDER x, PURCHASEBILLDETAIL Y
         Where x.tno = y.purchaseordertno
           And y.tno = a.tno
           And rownum = 1) As AgentName,

       Decode((Select yy.itemnaturename
                From item xx, itemnature yy, purchasebilldetail zz
               Where xx.itemnaturecode = yy.itemnaturecode
                 And xx.itemcode = zz.itemcode
                 And zz.tno = a.tno
                 And Rownum = 1),
              'STOREITEM',
              'STOREITEM',

              (Select XX.itemname
                 From item xx, purchasebilldetail yy
                Where xx.itemcode = yy.itemcode
                  And yy.tno = a.tno
                  And Rownum = 1)

              ) As ItemName,
       (Select Sum(quantity1) From pbpassdetail x Where x.tno = b.tno) PassQuantity,

       (Select GETPARTYNAME(x.partycode) || ' / @ ' || to_char(z.rate) ||
               ' / ' || TO_CHAR(Z.QUANTITY1) || ' ' ||
               Z.RATEMEASURINGUNITCODE || ' / ' || x.freighttypecode ||
               ' / ' || to_char(x.freightrate)
          From PURCHASEORDER x, PURCHASEBILLDETAIL Y, PURCHASEORDERDETAIL Z
         Where x.tno = y.purchaseordertno
           And x.tno = z.tno
           And y.tno = a.tno
           And rownum = 1) As PODetail,
       (Select x.purchaseorderno || ' / ' ||
               to_char(x.purchaseorderdate, 'DD-MON-RRRR')||
               to_char(x.deliverydate, 'DD-MON-RRRR')
          From PURCHASEORDER x, PURCHASEBILLDETAIL Y
         Where x.tno = y.purchaseordertno
           And y.tno = a.tno
           And rownum = 1) As PONO

  From PURCHASEBILL a,
       PBPASS b,

select q."TNO",q."COMPANYCODE",q."FINANCIALYEARCODE",q."LOCATIONCODE",q."DOCTYPECODE",q."PARTYQUOTATIONNO",q."PARTYQUOTATIONDATE",q."PARTYCODE",q."EMPLOYEECODE",q."VALIDITYDATE",q."CURRENCYUNITCODE",q."CURRENCYVALUE",q."SUMOFAMOUNT",q."SUMOFFOOTER",q."SUBJECTTEXT",q."REFERENCETEXT",q."LETTERTEXT",q."TITLETEXT",q."ITEMWISEFOOTER",q."REMARK",q."SUMOFFOOTERAMOUNT",q."SALESQUOTATIONNO",q."SALESQUOTATIONDATE",q."SALESQUOTATIONAMOUNT",q."SALESENQUIRYTNO",q."AGENTCODE",q."CONSIGNEECODE",q."VALIDITYUPTODATE",q."CREATIONTIME",q."CREATOR",q."REVISIONSALESQUOTATIONTNO",q."ROUNDINGAMOUNT",q."REASONOFLOSS",

select s."TNO",s."COMPANYCODE",s."FINANCIALYEARCODE",s."LOCATIONCODE",s."DOCTYPECODE",s."SALESORDERNO",s."SALESORDERDATE",s."DEPARTMENTCODE",s."EMPLOYEECODE",s."DELIVERYDATE",s."CURRENCYUNITCODE",s."CURRENCYVALUE",s."PARTYCODE",s."AGENTCODE",s."CONSIGNEECODE",s."SALESEXECUTIVECODE",s."SUMOFAMOUNT",s."SUMOFFOOTERAMOUNT",s."SALESORDERAMOUNT",s."SUBJECTTEXT",s."REFERENCETEXT",s."LETTERTEXT",s."TITLETEXT",s."REMARK",s."ITEMWISEFOOTER",s."REFERENCETNO",s."VALIDITYUPTODATE",s."VALIDITYDAYS",s."CREDITDAYS",s."COMMISSIONRATE",s."TRANSPORTERCODE",s."FREIGHTTYPECODE",s."DESPATCHCATEGORYCODE",s."CREATOR",s."CREATIONTIME",s."FROMCITYCODE",s."TOCITYCODE",s."TRANSACTIONTYPECODE",s."NATUREOFSUPPLYCODE",s."PARTYPONO",s."PARTYPODATE",s."EXECUTEDAT",s."PORECEIPTTNO",s."ISOPENSPEC",s."QUANTITY",s."TRADEDISCOUNTTNO",s."TRADETYPECODE",s."REVISIONSALESORDERTNO",s."PURCHASEORDERTNO",s."WORKORDERTNO",s."DELIVERYORDERTNO",s."SALESQUOTATIONTNO",
       coalesce(
         s.salesquotationtno,
         (select max(pr.salesquotationtno)
            from poreceipt pr
           where pr.tno=s.poreceipttno)
       ) salesconfirmtno,
       (select max(da.vehicleno)
          from despatchadvice da
         where da.salesordertno = s.tno) vehicleno,
       cast('A' as varchar2(10)) panel
  from salesorder s

with confirmed as (
  select d.tno, sum(nvl(d.quantity1,0)) scqty
    from slc_salesconfirmdetail d group by d.tno
), ordered as (
  select so.salesconfirmtno tno, sum(nvl(d.quantity1,0)) soqty
    from slc_salesorder so
    join salesorderdetail d on d.tno=so.tno
   group by so.salesconfirmtno
), dispatched as (
  select so.salesconfirmtno tno, sum(nvl(d.quantity1,0)) daqty
    from slc_salesorder so
    join despatchadvice da on da.salesordertno=so.tno
    join despatchadvicedetail d on d.tno=da.tno
   group by so.salesconfirmtno
), invoiced as (
  select so.salesconfirmtno tno, sum(nvl(d.quantity1,0)) ccqty
    from slc_salesorder so
    join ccinvoice ci on ci.salesordertno=so.tno
    join ccinvoicedetail d on d.tno=ci.tno
   group by so.salesconfirmtno
)
select sc.tno,
       sc.salesconfirmno,
       sc.salesconfirmdate,
       getpartyname(sc.partycode) partyname,
       nvl(c.scqty,0) scqty,
       nvl(o.soqty,0) soqty,
       nvl(d.daqty,0) daqty,
       nvl(i.ccqty,0) ccqty,
       greatest(nvl(c.scqty,0)-nvl(i.ccqty,0),0) balanceqty
  from slc_salesconfirm sc
  left join confirmed c on c.tno=sc.tno
  left join ordered o on o.tno=sc.tno
  left join dispatched d on d.tno=sc.tno
  left join invoiced i on i.tno=sc.tno

select
        rownum as MyTNo,zz.TRANSACTIONNO,
        zz."COMMONTNO",zz."STOCKTNO",zz."USEDSTOCKTNO",zz."ITEMCODE",zz."ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE",zz."STOCKTYPE",zz."TNO",zz."TRANSACTIONDATE",zz."MODULECODE",zz."MODULETNO",zz."COMPANYCODE",zz."FINANCIALYEARCODE",zz."QUANTITY1",zz."QUANTITY2",zz."RATE",zz."AMOUNT",zz."STOCKINQUANTITY1",zz."STOCKINQUANTITY2",zz."STOCKINAMOUNT",zz."STOCKOUTQUANTITY1",zz."STOCKOUTQUANTITY2",zz."STOCKOUTAMOUNT",zz."LOCATIONCODE"
    from (
  select
   z.*
  from (
  select
   a.TNo as CommonTNo,
   a.TNo  as StockTNo,
   null as UsedStockTNo,
   a.ItemCode,
   a.ItemSpecificationCode,
   'IN' AS StockType,
   a.TNo,
   a.StockDate as TransactionDate,
   a.StockModuleCode as ModuleCode,
	 Case When a.StockModuleCode = 'INSPECTION' Then
            a.GRNTNo
				Else
					  a.StockModuleTno
	 End ModuleTno,
   a.CompanyCode,
   a.FinancialYearCode,
   a.StockQuantity1 as Quantity1,
   a.StockQuantity2 as Quantity2,
   a.Rate,
   a.Amount,
   a.StockQuantity1 as StockInQuantity1,
   a.StockQuantity2 as StockInQuantity2,
   a.Amount as StockInAmount,
   null as StockOutQuantity1,
   null as StockOutQuantity2,
   null as StockOutAmount,
   a.LocationCode,
	 Case When GRNTNO Is Not Null And a.StockModuleCode = 'INSPECTION' Then
		         GetModuleNo('GRN',A.GRNTNO)
				Else
					   GetModuleNo(A.STOCKMODULECODE,A.STOCKMODULETNO)
	End TRANSACTIONNO
  from Stock a
  where a.StockModuleCode != 'ITEMOPENING'

  union all
  select
   a.TNo as CommonTNo,
   null as StockTNo,
   a.TNO as UsedStockTNO,
   b.ItemCode,
   b.ItemSpecificationCode,
   'OUT' AS StockType,
   b.TNo,
   a.UsedStockDate as TransactionDate,
   a.ModuleCode,
   a.ModuleTNo,
   a.CompanyCode,
   a.FinancialYearCode,
   (-1) * a.UsedStockQuantity1 as Quantity1,
   (-1) * a.UsedStockQuantity2 as Quantity2,
   b.Rate,
   (-1) * b.Rate * a.UsedStockQuantity1 as Amount,
   null as StockInQuantity1,
   null as StockInQuantity2,
   null as StockInAmount,
   a.UsedStockQuantity1 as StockOutQuantity1,
   a.UsedStockQuantity2 as StockOutQuantity2,
   b.Rate * a.UsedStockQuantity1 as StockOutAmount,
   a.LocationCode,
  GetModuleNo(A.MODULECODE,A.MODULETNO) As TRANSACTIONNO
  from UsedStock a, Stock b
  where a.StockTNO = b.TNO
  ) z
  order by z.TransactionDate, z.StockType, z.CommonTNo
    ) zz

WITH AGGR_DESPATCH AS (
    -- Step 1: Pre-aggregate Dispatches at the exact item-line level
    SELECT
        DA_MAIN.REFERENCETNO AS SO_TNO,
        DAD_SUB.ITEMCODE,
        DAD_SUB.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE,
        DA_MAIN.DESPATCHADVICENO,
        DA_MAIN.DESPATCHADVICEDATE,
        SUM(DAD_SUB.QUANTITY1) AS TOTAL_DISPATCH_QTY
    FROM DESPATCHADVICE DA_MAIN
    JOIN DESPATCHADVICEDETAIL DAD_SUB ON DAD_SUB.TNO = DA_MAIN.TNO
    GROUP BY DA_MAIN.REFERENCETNO, DA_MAIN.DESPATCHADVICENO, DA_MAIN.DESPATCHADVICEDATE, DAD_SUB.ITEMCODE, DAD_SUB.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE
),
AGGR_LOADING AS (
    -- Step 2: Pre-aggregate Loading Advice at the exact item-line level
    SELECT
        LA_MAIN.SALESORDERTNO AS SO_TNO,
        LAD_SUB.ITEMCODE,
        LAD_SUB.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE,
        LA_MAIN.LOADINGADVICENO,
        LA_MAIN.LOADINGADVICEDATE,
        SUM(LAD_SUB.QUANTITY1) AS TOTAL_LOADING_QTY
    FROM LOADINGADVICE LA_MAIN
    JOIN LOADINGADVICEDETAIL LAD_SUB ON LAD_SUB.TNO = LA_MAIN.TNO
    GROUP BY LA_MAIN.SALESORDERTNO, LA_MAIN.LOADINGADVICENO, LA_MAIN.LOADINGADVICEDATE, LAD_SUB.ITEMCODE, LAD_SUB.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE
)
SELECT
     SO.TNO AS SALES_ORDER_TNO
    ,SO.FINANCIALYEARCODE
    ,SO.COMPANYCODE
    ,SO.LOCATIONCODE
    ,SO.DOCTYPECODE AS SO_DOCTYPECODE
    ,SO.SALESORDERNO
    ,SO.SALESORDERDATE
    ,SO.PARTYCODE
    ,P.PARTYNAME
    ,SO.SALESEXECUTIVECODE
    ,E.EMPLOYEENAME
    ,VI.ITEMCODE
    ,VI.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE
    ,VI.ITEMNAME
    ,VI.ITEMSPECIFICATIONNAME
    ,VI.ITEMCATEGORYCODE
    ,VI.ITEMCATEGORYNAME
    , SOD.QUANTITY1 AS ORDERED_QTY
    ,SOD.RATE
    ,SOD.AMOUNT AS BASE_AMOUNT
    ,SOD.FOOTERAMOUNT
    ,SOD.TOTALAMOUNT AS SO_TOTAL_AMOUNT
    ,GETDOCUMENTSTATUSCODE('SALESORDER', SO.TNO) AS SO_STATUS

    -- Dispatch Details
    ,DA.DESPATCHADVICENO
    ,DA.DESPATCHADVICEDATE
    ,NVL(DA.TOTAL_DISPATCH_QTY, 0) AS DISPATCHED_QTY

    -- Loading Details
    ,LA.LOADINGADVICENO
    ,LA.LOADINGADVICEDATE
    ,NVL(LA.TOTAL_LOADING_QTY, 0) AS LOADINGADVICE_QTY

    -- 1. Strict Pending Dispatch Qty (Ordered - Connected Dispatch Only)
    ,GREATEST(SOD.QUANTITY1 - NVL(DA.TOTAL_DISPATCH_QTY, 0), 0) AS PENDING_DESPATCH_QTY

    -- 2. Strict Pending Loading Qty (Ordered - Connected Loading Only)
    ,GREATEST(SOD.QUANTITY1 - NVL(LA.TOTAL_LOADING_QTY, 0), 0) AS PENDING_LOADING_QTY

    -- 3. Unified Balance Pending Qty (Handles either Despatch or Loading pipeline)
    ,GREATEST(SOD.QUANTITY1 - NVL(DA.TOTAL_DISPATCH_QTY, 0) - NVL(LA.TOTAL_LOADING_QTY, 0), 0) AS BALANCE_PENDING_QTY

    -- 4. Cancelled / Short-Closed Qty Logic
    ,CASE
        WHEN GETDOCUMENTSTATUSCODE('SALESORDER', SO.TNO) = 'SHORTCLOSED'
        THEN GREATEST(SOD.QUANTITY1 - NVL(DA.TOTAL_DISPATCH_QTY, 0) - NVL(LA.TOTAL_LOADING_QTY, 0), 0)
        ELSE 0
     END AS CANCELLED_QTY

FROM SALESORDER SO
JOIN SALESORDERDETAIL SOD ON SO.TNO = SOD.TNO
LEFT JOIN PARTY P ON SO.PARTYCODE = P.PARTYCODE
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMPLOYEECODE = SO.SALESEXECUTIVECODE
LEFT JOIN V_ITEM_DETAILS VI ON VI.ITEMCODE = SOD.ITEMCODE AND VI.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE = SOD.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE
LEFT JOIN FINANCIALYEAR FY ON SO.FINANCIALYEARCODE = FY.FINANCIALYEARCODE
LEFT JOIN AGGR_DESPATCH DA ON DA.SO_TNO = SO.TNO AND DA.ITEMCODE = SOD.ITEMCODE AND DA.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE = SOD.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE
LEFT JOIN AGGR_LOADING LA ON LA.SO_TNO = SO.TNO AND LA.ITEMCODE = SOD.ITEMCODE AND LA.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE = SOD.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE

WITH REVISION_TREE AS (
    SELECT
        TNO AS CURRENT_SO_TNO,
        SalesOrderNo AS CURRENT_SO_NO,
        CONNECT_BY_ROOT TNO AS ROOT_SO_TNO,
        CONNECT_BY_ROOT SalesOrderNo AS ROOT_SO_NO
    FROM SalesOrder
    START WITH REVISIONSALESORDERTNO IS NULL
    CONNECT BY PRIOR TNO = REVISIONSALESORDERTNO
),
root_so_quantities AS (
    -- Fetch original baseline transaction targets
    SELECT sod.TNO, sod.ITEMCODE, sod.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE, NVL(sod.Quantity1, 0) AS BASE_SO_QTY, NVL(sod.RATE, 0) AS BASE_SO_RATE, NVL(sod.TotalAmount,0) as BASE_SO_AMOUNT
    FROM SalesOrderDetail sod
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    so.TNO,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(so.SalesOrderNo, '.*/0*([0-9]+)', '0\1') AS SO_No_Clean,
    so.SalesOrderDate,
    so.SalesOrderNo,
    so.PartyPONO,
    so.PartyPODate,
    so.PartyCode,
    so.Agentcode,
    so.SALESEXECUTIVECODE,
    so.REMARK,
    sod.ITEMCODE,
    sod.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE,
    NVL(sod.Quantity1, 0) AS CURRENT_SO_QTY,
    sod.Rate,
    sod.Amount,
    rt.ROOT_SO_TNO,
    rt.ROOT_SO_NO,
    NVL(rsq.BASE_SO_QTY, 0) AS BASE_SO_QTY,
    NVL(rsq.BASE_SO_RATE, 0) AS BASE_SO_RATE,
    NVL(rsq.BASE_SO_AMOUNT,0) AS BASE_SO_AMOUNT
FROM SalesOrder so
JOIN REVISION_TREE rt ON so.TNO = rt.CURRENT_SO_TNO
JOIN SalesOrderDetail sod ON so.TNo = sod.TNO
LEFT JOIN root_so_quantities rsq ON rt.ROOT_SO_TNO = rsq.TNO
    AND sod.ItemCode = rsq.ItemCode
    AND sod.ItemSpecificationCode = rsq.ItemSpecificationCode
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM DOCUMENTSTATUSDETAIL dsd
    WHERE dsd.MODULECODE = 'SALESORDER'
      AND dsd.MODULETNO = so.TNO
      AND dsd.DOCUMENTSTATUSCODE = 'ACTIVE'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM SalesOrder child_so
    WHERE child_so.REVISIONSALESORDERTNO = so.TNO
)

WITH Amendment_Hierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        TNO AS Amendment_TNO,
        PURCHASEORDERTNO,
        PARTYCODE,
        CONNECT_BY_ROOT PURCHASEORDERTNO AS ROOT_PO_TNO,
        CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF AS IsLatest
    FROM POAmendment
    START WITH PURCHASEORDERTNO IS NOT NULL
    CONNECT BY PRIOR TNO = PURCHASEORDERTNO
),
Latest_Amendments AS (
    SELECT
        ROOT_PO_TNO AS PO_TNO,
        PARTYCODE,
        Amendment_TNO
    FROM Amendment_Hierarchy
    WHERE IsLatest = 1
),
CombinedRecords AS (
    SELECT
        po.TNO AS PO_TNO,
        pod.TNO AS Source_TNO,
        'ORIGINAL' AS Record_Type,
        po.PARTYCODE,
        po.PURCHASEORDERNO,
        po.PURCHASEORDERDATE,
        null as PO_AMENDMENT_NO,
        null as PO_AMENDMENT_DATE,
        pod.ITEMCODE,
        pod.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE,
        pod.QUANTITY1,
        pod.RATE,
        pod.AMOUNT
    FROM PurchaseOrder po
    JOIN PurchaseOrderDetail pod ON po.TNO = pod.TNO

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        la.PO_TNO,
        pad.TNO AS Source_TNO,
        'AMENDED' AS Record_Type,
        la.PARTYCODE,
        (SELECT po.PURCHASEORDERNO FROM PURCHASEORDER po WHERE po.TNO = la.PO_TNO) AS PURCHASEORDERNO,
        (SELECT po.PURCHASEORDERDATE FROM PURCHASEORDER po WHERE po.TNO = la.PO_TNO) AS PURCHASEORDERDATE,
        (SELECT pa.POAMENDMENTNO FROM POAMENDMENT pa WHERE pa.TNO = pad.TNO) AS PO_AMENDMENT_NO,
        (SELECT pa.POAMENDMENTDATE FROM POAMENDMENT pa WHERE pa.TNO = pad.TNO) AS PO_AMENDMENT_DATE,
        pad.ITEMCODE,
        pad.ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE,
        pad.QUANTITY1,
        pad.RATE,
        pad.AMOUNT
    FROM Latest_Amendments la
    JOIN POAmendmentDetail pad ON la.Amendment_TNO = pad.TNO
),
FilteredRecords AS (
    SELECT
        PO_TNO,
        Source_TNO,
        Record_Type,
        PARTYCODE,
        PURCHASEORDERNO,
        PURCHASEORDERDATE,
        PO_AMENDMENT_NO,
        PO_AMENDMENT_DATE,
        ITEMCODE,
        ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE,
        QUANTITY1,
        RATE,
        AMOUNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Record_Type = 'AMENDED' THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY PO_TNO) AS Has_Amendment
    FROM CombinedRecords
)
SELECT
    PO_TNO AS BASE_PO_TNO,
    Source_TNO AS Latest_Detail_TNO,
    Record_Type,
    PARTYCODE,
    PURCHASEORDERNO,
    PURCHASEORDERDATE,
    PO_AMENDMENT_NO,
    PO_AMENDMENT_DATE,
    ITEMCODE,
    ITEMSPECIFICATIONCODE,
    QUANTITY1,
    RATE,
    AMOUNT
FROM FilteredRecords
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND (
        (Has_Amendment > 0 AND Record_Type = 'AMENDED')
        OR
        (Has_Amendment = 0 AND Record_Type = 'ORIGINAL')
      )

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY zz.TransactionDate, zz.StockType, zz.CommonTNo
    ) AS MyTNo,

    zz.TRANSACTIONNO,
    zz.CommonTNo,
    zz.StockTNo,
    zz.UsedStockTNo,
    zz.ItemCode,
    zz.ItemSpecificationCode,
    zz.StockType,
    zz.TNo,
    zz.TransactionDate,
    zz.ModuleCode,
    zz.ModuleTNo,
    zz.CompanyCode,
    zz.FinancialYearCode,
    zz.Quantity1,
    zz.Quantity2,
    zz.Rate,
    zz.Amount,
    zz.StockInQuantity1,
    zz.StockInQuantity2,
    zz.StockInAmount,
    zz.StockOutQuantity1,
    zz.StockOutQuantity2,
    zz.StockOutAmount,
    zz.LocationCode

FROM (

    /* ===================== STOCK IN ===================== */
    SELECT
        a.TNo AS CommonTNo,
        a.TNo AS StockTNo,
        NULL AS UsedStockTNo,
        a.ItemCode,
        a.ItemSpecificationCode,
        'IN' AS StockType,
        a.TNo,
        a.StockDate AS TransactionDate,
        a.StockModuleCode AS ModuleCode,

        CASE
            WHEN a.StockModuleCode = 'INSPECTION' THEN a.GRNTNo
            ELSE a.StockModuleTno
        END AS ModuleTno,

        a.CompanyCode,
        a.FinancialYearCode,

        a.StockQuantity1 AS Quantity1,
        a.StockQuantity2 AS Quantity2,
        a.Rate,
        a.Amount,

        a.StockQuantity1 AS StockInQuantity1,
        a.StockQuantity2 AS StockInQuantity2,
        a.Amount AS StockInAmount,

        NULL AS StockOutQuantity1,
        NULL AS StockOutQuantity2,
        NULL AS StockOutAmount,

        a.LocationCode,

        CASE
            WHEN a.GRNTNO IS NOT NULL AND a.StockModuleCode = 'INSPECTION' THEN
                GetModuleNo('GRN', a.GRNTNO)
            ELSE
                GetModuleNo(a.StockModuleCode, a.StockModuleTNO)
        END AS TRANSACTIONNO

    FROM Stock a
    WHERE a.StockModuleCode <> 'ITEMOPENING'


    UNION ALL


    /* ===================== STOCK OUT ===================== */
    SELECT
        a.TNo AS CommonTNo,
        NULL AS StockTNo,
        a.TNo AS UsedStockTNo,
        b.ItemCode,
        b.ItemSpecificationCode,
        'OUT' AS StockType,
        b.TNo,

        a.UsedStockDate AS TransactionDate,
        a.ModuleCode,
        a.ModuleTNo,

        a.CompanyCode,
        a.FinancialYearCode,

        -a.UsedStockQuantity1 AS Quantity1,
        -a.UsedStockQuantity2 AS Quantity2,

        b.Rate,
        -b.Rate * a.UsedStockQuantity1 AS Amount,

        NULL AS StockInQuantity1,
        NULL AS StockInQuantity2,
        NULL AS StockInAmount,

        a.UsedStockQuantity1 AS StockOutQuantity1,
        a.UsedStockQuantity2 AS StockOutQuantity2,
        b.Rate * a.UsedStockQuantity1 AS StockOutAmount,

        a.LocationCode,

        GetModuleNo(a.ModuleCode, a.ModuleTNo) AS TRANSACTIONNO

    FROM UsedStock a
    JOIN Stock b
        ON a.StockTNO = b.TNO

) zz
